name: Qiu Jin
shortBio: Late-Qing Chinese feminist philosopher and anti-imperial revolutionary who attacked footbinding, Confucian patriarchal subordination, and dynastic autocracy as inseparable barriers to human emancipation.
centralQuestion: Why must political revolution against imperial autocracy be inseparable from the bodily and educational liberation of women?

keyWorks.title: Respectful Announcement to China's Two Hundred Million Women Comrades
keyWorks.description: Manifesto condemning footbinding, arranged marriage, and intellectual confinement as systemic slavery undermining collective self-rule.

keyWorks.title: Stones of the Jingwei Bird (Jingwei Shi)
keyWorks.description: Allegorical philosophical narrative envisioning egalitarian civic solidarity and women's self-emancipation.
